title:

(button should be enabled). Otherwise, return true. (button should be disabled)

Expects a JSON object as argument with the following properties:
- templateSlots (json): the value for {@link BulkModelConfigUiSettings#templateSlots} in the App state
- slotIndex (int): the template slot index based on the current substep index for bulk model config workflow
